summary: Dependency resolved from unpinned GitHub tarball on an anonymous account
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `node-net-pool` as a direct tarball URL pointing at the mutable `main` branch of an anonymous GitHub account (`trktgq0wbre1/node-net-pool`) unrelated to the package's declared publisher. `npm install` fetches whatever bytes are at that URL at install time, without a registry version range, without a pinned commit SHA, and without an integrity hash, and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in that tarball on the installer's machine. lib/cache.js additionally `require('node-net-pool')` at import time, so the same attacker-controlled code loads whenever the package is imported. The account owner can rewrite the branch contents at any moment. The shipped source presents as a Discord MFA / vanity-URL automation library (PATCH /api/v9/guilds/0/vanity-url, POST /api/v9/mfa/finish, with TLS verification disabled via `rejectUnauthorized: false`), serving as cover for the off-registry dependency source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
